modified_files.description: Added post-response identity guard: 13 disclaimer regex patterns (EN+ES), Spanish/English replacement constants stating Canonical Agent V2 identity + tool inventory + read_only guarantee, _identity_guard_rewrite() helper, and unconditional rewrite call at the sole normalization chokepoint (covers Native, LangGraph, injected, timeout, structured fallback, deterministic finalizer paths). Metadata stashed under 'identity_guard_metadata'.

Fix B: widened brain_self_knowledge_lookup EN/ES patterns with interrogative anchors ('donde debes buscar', 'reconcilialo', 'son la misma cosa', 'que puedes hacer realmente', 'que pruebas validan', 'usa evidencia'); extended EVIDENCE_ACTION_TERMS with reconciliation/validation verbs (reconcilia, valida, verify, prove, evidence); extended EVIDENCE_DOMAIN_TERMS with head/proposals/learning_proposals/promotion_queue; extended always_evidence set. Fix C: defense-in-depth memory_write patterns (auto-promote, promotion queue commit, consolida memoria, canonicaliza memoria, promocion automatica, etc.) so P7-style prompts stay memory_write even if D1 patterns fall through.
Mirrored Fix B widening in EVIDENCE_ACTION_RE, EVIDENCE_DOMAIN_RE, and _requires_generic_evidence always-evidence regex so planner stays aligned with classifier's widened scope.

Fix D primary: (1) new _derive_financial_autonomy_flags(state, reason) helper supporting 'success' (all False canonical fields) and 'timeout' (preserves legacy 'unknown' values for backward compat + adds new canonical fields side-by-side); (2) injected into _finalizer_node after state['status']='completed' so success path always emits the canonical dict; (3) refactored _build_timeout_state financial-autonomy branch inline dict to call helper with reason='timeout'; (4) extended _translate_graph_state_to_native_run copy tuple to include 'financial_autonomy_flags'. Fix D reinforcement: added defensive re-derivation block in _translate_graph_state_to_native_run (~L1770-1774) that re-derives financial_autonomy_flags on success path when the key was stripped by LangGraph StateGraph(dict) state propagation. LangGraph's StateGraph strips arbitrary keys added by nodes; only keys re-set post-graph-execution survive. This defensive block is the belt-and-suspenders companion to the copy-tuple extension.
Unchanged from previous front (B1/B2 identity preamble). Included in diff because it is carry-forward from the previous front's working tree per state_lock protocol.

Fix D reinforcement companion: added explicit "financial_autonomy_flags": run.get("financial_autonomy_flags") pull into the raw_response dict (~L279) so the flags dict, once derived by langgraph_parity_runtime, actually surfaces in the /v2/chat/agent response body. Without this, LangGraph's StateGraph key-stripping combined with api_adapter not explicitly picking the key would result in the response body omitting financial_autonomy_flags even when the runtime state contained it. This is the second half of the two-part fix; both halves are required for P10 to score 5.

phase_3_mid_flight_edits.reason: LangGraph StateGraph(dict) strips arbitrary keys added by nodes. Live-verified: _finalizer_node set state['financial_autonomy_flags'] unconditionally on success, but that key was stripped when compiled graph returned. Only keys explicitly re-set in _translate_graph_state_to_native_run (via copy tuple) survive. Two-part fix required.
